personality_one_liner: A tactical, high-contrast command center optimized for rapid, sweaty logging and performance tracking.

spacing.rule: Compact visual grouping for data density but generous touch targets (min 44pt height) for inputs and buttons. Use md (12) for margins between data rows.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and strong dividers for performance-first utility
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a tactical workout app; clarity and contrast beat aesthetics.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing today's date, the active/next workout, and quick actions to start training.

states.empty: No planned workout today: Show empty state illustration with 'Nessun allenamento programmato per oggi' and a primary CTA 'Nuovo Allenamento'
states.error: Error loading data with a Retry button

screens.layout: Top section: Date and a brand-tinted gradient header. Middle section: 'Allenamento di Oggi' card (surfaceSecondary) showing planned exercises. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Inizia Allenamento' fixed above the bottom tab bar. Safe-area accounted for.

screens.name: WorkoutEditor
screens.purpose: Live tracking and editing of a workout session, fully offline.

states.empty: No exercises added: Display 'Aggiungi il tuo primo esercizio' with an 'Aggiungi Esercizio' button

screens.layout: Header: Workout name input and global rest timer. List of Exercise Cards. Each card uses a compact layout: Title on top, column headers (Serie, Peso, Reps, Riposo). Each set is a tight row with numeric inputs (surfaceTertiary background, min-height 44pt) and a trailing checkbox to mark as done. Sticky CTA at the bottom 'Termina Allenamento'.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Monthly view with highlighted dots on days when workouts occurred.
screens.layout: Full-width monthly calendar grid. Dots under dates (brandPrimary) indicate workouts. Tapping a date reveals a scrollable list of workout summary cards for that day below the calendar.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Archive of all past workouts with powerful filtering.

states.empty: Grayscale weights image + 'Nessun allenamento trovato. Inizia ad allenarti!'

screens.layout: Top sticky header with a horizontal scrollable row of filter chips (Data, Gruppo muscolare, Esercizio). Below: Scrollable list of workout cards. Each card displays date, total volume, duration, and a truncated list of exercises.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Visualizes strength progression over time with charts.

states.empty: Atmospheric dark locker room image + 'Dati insufficienti. Registra più allenamenti per vedere i progressi.'

screens.layout: Exercise selector dropdown at the top. Main content: Line chart (using brandPrimary color) showing 1RM or Max Weight over time. Below chart: stat blocks showing 'Massimo (1RM)', 'Volume totale', and 'Frequenza'.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: List of configuration rows (surfaceSecondary). Toggle for Theme (Scuro/Chiaro). Backup section with 'Esporta CSV' and 'Ripristina JSON' buttons using brandSecondary colors.

empty_progress.alt: Dark urban night scene with benches

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines. Pure black is avoided; use the zinc-based deep slate palette (surface: #09090B, surfaceSecondary: #18181B).
Accent color is a warm, energetic Signal Orange (#FF5A00) indicating heat and effort.

Compact Exercise Row: Each row must contain Set index, Peso input, Reps input, and a Checkmark button. All fields must sit on one horizontal line per set, using surfaceTertiary for input backgrounds. Ensure inputs are min 44pt height for touch-friendliness even if visually compact.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for numerical data, scores, timers, and large headers. Use Satoshi for readable body text and labels.

The Rest Timer should be an overlay or fixed module at the top/bottom that vibrates and plays a system sound upon completion. Include 'haptics' on buttons like 'Add Set', 'Check Set', and 'Start Rest'.
No glassmorphism. Elevated elements must use solid surfaceSecondary and strong borders (#27272A).
Language is Italian. Always use 'Serie', 'Reps', 'Peso', 'Riposo', 'Inizia Allenamento', etc.
Sticky primary CTAs ('Inizia Allenamento' / 'Termina Allenamento') must be pinned to the bottom of the screen (above safe area / tab bar) to be always accessible without scrolling.
Image Scrim Rule: Any time text is overlaid on home_hero, ensure a vertical top-to-bottom linear gradient (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) is applied behind the text.
